NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 8 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 29, 9:10 AM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate at 21.1 DraftKings points for $8,600, against the Chargers. CeeDee Lamb (19.3, $8,100) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (18.1, $8,000) are next.

Zay Flowers returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.46 projected points per $1,000 at $7,200.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 29, 9:10 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 8

Puka Nacua, LAR vs LAC ($8,600)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.1 DraftKings points at $8,600. That is 1.8 points clear of CeeDee Lamb. The model gives him 10.6 targets on 30.2 routes. The salary works out to 2.46 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 33 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 21.3 points with a simulated floor of 8.0 and a ceiling of 45.2, and he holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 6.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 44.5.

CeeDee Lamb, DAL vs ARI ($8,100)

CeeDee Lamb projects 2nd at the position with 19.3 DraftKings points at $8,100. The model gives him 9.7 targets on 33.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.39 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 33 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 19.4 points with a simulated floor of 6.2 and a ceiling of 44.8, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 6-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 30.25 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET vs MIN ($8,000)

Amon-Ra St. Brown projects 3rd at the position with 18.1 DraftKings points at $8,000. The model gives him 9.8 targets on 32.8 routes. The salary works out to 2.26 projected points per $1,000, 10th of 33 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 18.1 points with a simulated floor of 5.3 and a ceiling of 42.5, and he holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3-point favorite at home against Minnesota, with an implied team total of 24.75 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Value: Carnell Tate, TEN at CIN ($5,200)

Carnell Tate projects for 12.2 DraftKings points at $5,200, which works out to 2.34 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 33 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 7.9 targets on 30.6 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Tate averaged 11.9 points with a simulated floor of 0.4 and a ceiling of 38.4, and he holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Tennessee is a 10-point underdog on the road against Cincinnati, with an implied team total of 18.25 in a game totaled at 46.5.
